title: Task Priority Levels
overview: Add priority levels (High, Medium, Low) to tasks in the Task Manager application, allowing users to categorize and visually distinguish tasks by importance.

problemStatement.description: Currently, all tasks appear with equal visual weight.
painPoints: Cannot identify urgent tasks at a glance
Cannot focus on high-priority items first

goalsAndMetrics.metric: Users can assign priority to 100% of tasks
Priority indicated visually within 1 second of viewing
No more than 1 additional click to set priority

userStories.action: assign a priority level when creating a task
change the priority of an existing task
new tasks default to Medium priority
userStories.benefit: don't have to set it every time

functionalRequirements.title: Priority Data Model
requirements: Add priority field to Task interface

functionalRequirements.title: Priority Selection on Create
requirements: Add priority selector to task creation form

functionalRequirements.title: Priority Display
requirements: Show priority indicator on each task card

functionalRequirements.title: Priority Editing
requirements: Allow changing priority on existing tasks

functionalRequirements.title: State Management
requirements: Update Task[] state to persist priority

nonFunctionalRequirements.specification: Priority change must update UI in < 100ms
Priority selector must be keyboard navigable

uiuxConsiderations: Priority selector: Dropdown or segmented button group
Badge position: After task title, before delete button
Include text label with color for accessibility
